_about: Content Civitas published and withdrew, with the reason. An issue entry's issues are removed from the database by an Alembic data migration (named in `migration`), the API answers 410 with the reason (the issue page shows it, marked noindex), and their posts are left out of the Atom feeds. A race-coverage entry names the coverage items (`coverageItems`, by URL, which a re-ingest keeps) and the posts (`broadcastPostIds`) it withdraws: the items are left off their race's page and the posts out of the Atom feeds and never sent again; it needs no migration (`migration` is null), since nothing is deleted. Entries are never removed from this file: it is the public record of what was withdrawn and why.

retractions.reason: Both issues were assembled by a clustering step that joined unrelated news stories into one (fixed 2026-09-27, PR #659). Issue i1679cbc7 combined floods in Bangkok, a hurricane near Hawaii, a nor'easter in the Northeast and an HIV emergency in Fiji; issue i612cf1a1, about the Trump-Xi summit, took its headline from an unrelated article and cited unrelated sources. Their Bluesky posts were written by a language model (the poster has since been changed to quote sources word for word, PR #660) and included statements no source made. The articles behind them are not stored, so they could not be corrected and were withdrawn.

A post on 17 October 2026 presented a story about two national figures campaigning in Michigan, and speculation about 2028, as an update on the New York 14th District House race. The source was a multi-story newsletter, and it was attached to that race only because it named one of the race's candidates in full; nothing else in it concerned that race. The election coverage ingest now drops multi-story digests and newsletters as the Action Center does, requires a story to name the race (its state or another of its candidates) as well as the candidate, and posts only stories that clear a relevance threshold fitted on labelled stories (PR #1093). The post is withdrawn from the Atom feeds and the story from the race page.
